issue.title: bob-mac-capture docs/protocol.md exceeds the 6000-word mounted reference budget (6003) since 8e2ecd7, failing bob-cli just docs-check
issue.description:
## What is wrong

bob-cli `just docs-check` fails at its lint stage on current master (bob-cli
0e11f8b0 with bob-mac-capture master 8e2ecd7 mounted):

    docs/reference/mac-capture/protocol.md:1: budget: over budget at 6003 words (cap 6000 for reference/)
    bob-docs lint: 1 error(s)

`docs/reference/mac-capture/protocol.md` is mounted from bob-mac-capture
`docs/protocol.md` (frontmatter `source: bob-mac-capture:docs/protocol.md`), so
the fix belongs in the bob-mac-capture repo.

## Root cause

Word counts with bob-docs' own `bob_docs.markdown.count_words` on each
bob-mac-capture revision of `docs/protocol.md`:

| bob-mac-capture commit | words |
| --- | --- |
| 5ef0224 (docs: json-outputs rebase conflict) | 5987 |
| 10470e7 (bob-cli-h2.6 Record past work card) | 5991 |
| 8e2ecd7 (feat(capture): forward backslash hash alias with double-tap literal; agent athena.185.f0.f2, no bead) | 6003 |

8e2ecd7 added 12 words and pushed the page over the 6000-word reference cap.
The page has been within ~15 words of the cap for several commits, so any
further protocol addition will keep tripping it.

## Fix

Tighten bob-mac-capture `docs/protocol.md` below 6000 words without dropping
contract facts (the compatibility table and capability rows are the densest
candidates for trimming duplicated prose), or split a coherent section into its
own mounted reference page if the docs memory/IA rules allow it. Then run
bob-mac-capture `just docs-check` and bob-cli `just docs-check` (which mounts the
sibling docs) to confirm the lint stage passes.
